blurb: The New York area's cruise gateway sits in Bayonne with the Manhattan skyline and Statue of Liberty in view. Driving distance for the entire tri-state area and an easy add-on city stay for everyone else.
highlights: Statue of Liberty views;20-30 min to Manhattan;huge drive-in market;pre-cruise NYC stay

blurb: An hour from Orlando's theme parks and next door to the Space Coast, this stop packs beaches rockets and attractions into one port day.
highlights: Kennedy Space Center;Cocoa Beach;Orlando parks within reach

blurb: Royal Caribbean's private Bahamian island splits into free and paid zones: most of the island including beaches pools and dining is included with your cruise while the waterpark a premium beach club and an adults-only beach cost extra. Drink and Wi-Fi packages bought for the ship work on the island too.
highlights: Included beaches and pools;waterpark at extra cost;adults-only beach option;packages extend ashore
notes: Facts stated in our own words - keep it that way

blurb: The Bahamian capital mixes white-sand beaches with colonial forts and a famously colorful waterfront. Day options run from straight beach time to dolphin encounters reef trips and jeep tours - or a short hop to Paradise Island.
highlights: Beaches;colonial forts;dolphin and reef excursions;Paradise Island

blurb: The world's cruise capital: easy airport connections year-round sailings and a night-before stay in South Beach if you want it.
highlights: Biggest US cruise hub;year-round departures;easy flights

blurb: Texas cruising without the flight: three terminals on the Gulf a drive from the entire region with parking lots and seawall hotels built around the cruise routine.
highlights: Drive-in port for Texas;park-and-cruise packages;seawall hotels

blurb: Mexico's busiest cruise island is famous for reef snorkeling beach clubs and an easy walkable port area.
highlights: Reef snorkeling;beach clubs;Mayan ruin trips via ferry

blurb: A purpose-built cruise port on the Yucatan coast with a swim-up-bar village vibe and access to quieter Mayan ruins.
